comparison: Measured program-positive versus program-negative marker-supported ventricular segments within the SAME section.
matching: Five nearest negative controls with replacement in standardized log1p measured transcript count, log1p cell area and log1p detected genes; exact strata for missing-nucleus-area status.
excluded_from_matching: No spatial coordinates, landmark distances or subtype labels used as matching covariates.
limits: Descriptive conditional sensitivity, not causal inference or an independent-animal test. RNA depth and cell area can themselves be biological mediators. Marker landmarks and segmentation need anatomical validation. Control draws are not independent replicates.
